def process(beach_files):
    import pandas as pd

    df = beach_files.copy()
    # normalize beach type + violation
    df['Beach Type Description'] = df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    v = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    # treat common variants as yes/no; others -> NA
    df['violation_bool'] = v.map({'yes': True, 'y': True, 'true': True,
                                 'no': False, 'n': False, 'false': False})

    marine = df[df['Beach Type Description'].eq('Marine') & df['violation_bool'].notna()].copy()
    out = (marine.groupby('Year', as_index=False)
                 .agg(n_samples=('violation_bool', 'size'),
                      n_exceed=('violation_bool', 'sum')))
    out['avg_exceedance_rate'] = out['n_exceed'] / out['n_samples']
    out = out.sort_values('Year')
    out['prev_year_rate'] = out['avg_exceedance_rate'].shift(1)
    out['rate_diff_vs_prev'] = out['avg_exceedance_rate'] - out['prev_year_rate']
    return out

def process(boston_rain, chatham_rain) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    def clean_rain(df):
        df = df.copy()
        # Keep only real year rows (numeric) and coerce
        df['Year_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
        df = df[df['Year_num'].notna()].copy()
        df['Year'] = df['Year_num'].astype(int)
        df = df.drop(columns=['Year_num'])

        # Coerce month columns to numeric; treat 'M' etc as NaN
        months = ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']
        for m in months:
            df[m] = pd.to_numeric(df[m], errors='coerce')

        # Impute missing values with median of that month across non-missing years
        for m in months:
            med = df[m].median(skipna=True)
            df[m] = df[m].fillna(med)

        df['summer_rain'] = df['Jun'] + df['Jul'] + df['Aug']
        return df[['Year', 'summer_rain']].sort_values('Year').reset_index(drop=True)

    b = clean_rain(boston_rain)
    c = clean_rain(chatham_rain)

    merged = b.merge(c, on='Year', how='inner', suffixes=('_boston', '_chatham'))
    merged['total_summer_rain'] = merged['summer_rain_boston'] + merged['summer_rain_chatham']
    merged = merged.sort_values('Year').reset_index(drop=True)
    merged['prev_total_summer_rain'] = merged['total_summer_rain'].shift(1)
    merged['rain_diff_vs_prev'] = merged['total_summer_rain'] - merged['prev_total_summer_rain']

    return merged[['Year','summer_rain_boston','summer_rain_chatham','total_summer_rain','prev_total_summer_rain','rain_diff_vs_prev']]

def process(marine_exceedance_by_year, rain_summer_yoy) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    m = marine_exceedance_by_year.copy()
    m['rate_diff_vs_prev'] = pd.to_numeric(m['rate_diff_vs_prev'], errors='coerce')
    # year with highest (max) YoY exceedance rate difference
    m_valid = m.dropna(subset=['rate_diff_vs_prev'])
    peak_exceed_year = int(m_valid.loc[m_valid['rate_diff_vs_prev'].idxmax(), 'Year'])

    r = rain_summer_yoy.copy()
    r['rain_diff_vs_prev'] = pd.to_numeric(r['rain_diff_vs_prev'], errors='coerce')
    r_valid = r.dropna(subset=['rain_diff_vs_prev'])
    peak_rain_year = int(r_valid.loc[r_valid['rain_diff_vs_prev'].idxmax(), 'Year'])

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'peak_exceed_year': peak_exceed_year,
        'peak_rain_year': peak_rain_year,
        'same_year': peak_exceed_year == peak_rain_year
    }])
